newsitem.title: USA: U.S. chain store sales up 1.3 pct - BTM/Schroders.
newsitem.headline: U.S. chain store sales up 1.3 pct - BTM/Schroders.

text.p: U.S. chain store sales rose 1.3 percent in the week ended March 8 from the prior week, according to the seasonally adjusted BTM/Schroders weekly chain store sales index.
Sales for the week were up 6.9 percent on a year-over-year basis, while the month-to-date index was up 1.3 percent from the prior month.
"Sales were generally on-to-above plan for most retailers," the report said.
"Some retailers attributed the strength to the beginning of the payroll cycle while others noted strength in the apparel and seasonal merchandise," it said.
The report, which is normally embargoed for 0900 EST/1400 GMT, was released early by other news services.
